blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important. We introduce StreamEval, a unified benchmark for interactive streaming video generation spanning five tasks: avatar dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. StreamEval comprises 300 scripted test cases lasting 15-300s, each specifying initial assets, incrementally arriving multimodal requests, and explicit requirements for state changes and content preservation. Performance is assessed along four evaluation dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination, instantiated through ten task-specific metrics on a 0-100 scale. Evaluating 37 distinct models across 300 test cases, we find that high visual quality and identity retention do not necessarily coincide with reliable request execution or sustained state consistency. In particular, request execution remains challenging: the highest task-specific scores are 36.90 for Following among seven avatar-performance models, 25.93 for Following in text-conditioned world generation, and 15.00 for Edit Success among three reported reference-editing models. These findings identify reliable request execution under timing and preservation constraints as a central challenge for advancing omni-modal real-time interactive systems. The leaderboard is available at https://streameval.ai
blocks.zh: 随着流媒体视频生成的进步,与生成的视频进行实时互动变得越来越重要. 我们引入了 StreamEval , 用于交互流视频生成的统一基准, 涉及五项任务:avatar对话、avatar性能、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑。 流线 Eval包含300个脚本测试案例,持续15-300小时,每个案例都具体说明初始资产,递增收到的多式联运请求,以及国家变更和内容保存的明确要求。 业绩按四个评价方面来评估:任务执行、状态一致性、视觉忠诚和视听协调,通过10项具体任务衡量标准在0-100尺度上进行即时评估。 在对300个测试案件中的37个不同模型进行评估后,我们发现,高视觉质量和保留身份并不一定与可靠的请求执行或持续的国家一致性相吻合。 特别是,执行请求仍然具有挑战性:在7个阿凡达性能模型中,任务特有分数最高的是36.90分,在文本条件世界一代中,为25.93分,在三个报告参考编辑模型中,为15.00分。 这些结论确定,在时间安排和保全限制下可靠地执行请求,是推进全方位实时互动系统的中心挑战。 领导牌可在https://streameval.ai上查阅。

Avatar panels show recorded frames; the world-generation panel illustrates a scenario. Editing uses a shared source video with text instructions or reference images that change over time.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As streaming video generation advances, enabling real-time interaction with generated video is becoming increasingly important [ 72 , 59 ] . Systems that generate video incrementally can accept new user inputs while a session is in progress [ 63 , 5 ] , supporting conversational avatars, controllable virtual worlds, and live video editing. Such settings require more than plausible individual frames or clips: generation and responsive control must remain aligned with incoming inputs as user requests and the surrounding context evolve over time.
blocks.zh: 随着流媒体视频生成的进步,与生成的视频进行实时互动变得日益重要[72,59]. 渐进生成视频的系统可以在会话进行中时接受新的用户输入[63,5],支持对话的可控虚拟世界,以及现场视频编辑. 这种设置需要的不仅仅是可信的单个框架或剪辑:随着用户请求和周围环境随时间演变,生成和响应控制必须与收到的输入保持一致。

blocks.en: Sustained interaction requires systems to execute new requests while preserving relevant prior content and state. A conversational avatar must respond in context without losing its identity or dialogue history; a generated world must accommodate new controls without disrupting unaffected scene content; and a video editor must apply, update, or remove edits while tracking an advancing source stream. Each request carries timing and scope requirements, defining when a change should occur, what it should modify, and what must remain intact. Evaluation must therefore assess both task execution and state consistency throughout a session alongside visual fidelity and audiovisual coordination.
blocks.zh: 持续的交互需要系统执行新的请求,同时保留相关的先前的内容和状态. 对话的异想天开必须在上下文中回应,而不会失去其身份或对话历史;生成的世界必须适应新的控制而不会干扰未受影响的场景内容;视频编辑器在跟踪前进的源流时必须应用,更新或删除编辑. 每项请求都载有时间和范围要求,界定何时应当发生改变,应当修改什么,以及必须保持不变什么。 因此,评价必须评估任务执行情况和整个会议的一致性,同时评估视觉忠诚和视听协调。

blocks.en: Existing benchmarks examine complementary aspects of these requirements. VBench and EvalCrafter assess visual quality and temporal behavior, while T2V-CompBench examines compositional alignment [ 21 , 41 , 51 ] . WBench and WBench-Editing evaluate multi-turn control, successive edits, and content preservation within generated worlds [ 68 , 36 ] . StreamAV-Bench assesses interactive updates and state retention in streaming audio-video generation [ 39 ] , and LongV2VBench examines editing quality over sustained source streams [ 59 ] . VideoFDB evaluates full-duplex conversational agents through their perception and generation of nonverbal audiovisual cues [ 44 ] . Its focus on conversational dynamics complements task-directed evaluation of request execution and state preservation. Building on these efforts, we bring avatar interaction, world generation, and real-time video editing into a unified benchmark with explicit, task-specific execution and preservation criteria.
blocks.zh: 现有基准审查这些要求的补充方面。 V Bench和EvalCrafter评估视觉质量和时间行为,而T2V-Comp Bench则审查组成对齐[21,41,51]. W Bench和W Bench-Editing评价多回合控制,相继编辑,以及生成世界内的内容保存[68,36]. StreamAV-Bench在流式音频视频生成中评估交互更新和状态保留[39],和LongV2 V Bench审查持续源流的编辑质量[59]. VideoFDB通过感知和生成非言语视听提示来评价全复式对话代理 [44]. 其重点是对话动态,是对以任务指导的方式对请求执行和保存状况的评价的补充。 在这些努力的基础上,我们把异形互动、世界一代和实时视频编辑纳入一个具有明确、具体任务执行和保存标准的统一基准。

blocks.en: We introduce StreamEval , spanning five tasks across these domains: digital-human dialogue, avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing ( figure 1 ). The benchmark contains 300 scripted test cases, each representing a 15–300 s interactive session. A test case bundles the initial portrait, scene, or source video with a sequence of timed user requests and explicit criteria for what the output should change and preserve. For example, an editing case may change one object, update another while retaining the first edit, then remove an edit to restore the source. Inputs arrive incrementally, so the system must respond as the session unfolds. Ten task-specific metrics evaluate performance along four complementary dimensions: task execution, state consistency, visual fidelity, and audiovisual coordination. This framework structures evaluation across tasks while respecting differences in model input interfaces and metric applicability.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍StreatEval, 涵盖五个领域的任务:数字-人类对话、阿凡达表演、世界一代、教学编辑和参考编辑(图1)。 该基准包含300个脚本测试案例,每个案例代表15-300次互动会话。 测试例将初始肖像、场景或源视频捆绑在一起,并附有按时间排序的用户请求,以及产出应改变和保存的明确标准。 例如,编辑大小写可能会改变一个对象,在保留第一个编辑的同时更新另一个对象,然后删除一个编辑以恢复源. 投入逐步到达,因此系统必须随着会话的展开而响应. 10个针对具体任务的衡量标准按照四个相辅相成的方面评价业绩:任务执行、国家一致性、视觉忠诚和视听协调。 这一框架结构评价涉及不同任务,同时尊重模型输入界面和衡量适用性的差异。

blocks.en: We evaluate 37 models on 300 test cases across five interactive streaming video tasks. Vidu S2 Avatar obtains the highest reported Dialogue score in digital-human dialogue. By Overall score, Vidu S2 Avatar leads avatar performance, MemFlow leads world generation, and Vidu S2 Editing leads both instruction and reference editing. Individual metrics reveal complementary strengths: LiveTalk obtains the highest Quality score in avatar performance, while JoyAI-Video-Edit obtains the highest Preservation score in instruction editing ( section 3.3 ). These results highlight distinct model strengths across tasks and interaction requirements. Looking ahead, we view real-time interactive video as an important challenge for bringing omni-modal models to diverse application settings.
blocks.zh: 我们通过5个互动流视频任务,对300个测试案例的37个模型进行评估。 Vidu S2 Avatar在数字-人类对话中获得最高的"对话"得分. 按总分,Vidu S2 Avatar领跑Avatar性能,MemFlow领跑世界一代,而Vidu S2 Edit同时领跑指令和参考编辑. 个人度量衡揭示了互补优势:LiveTalk在阿凡达性能中获得最高质量分,而JoyAI-Video-Edit在指令编辑中获得最高保存分(第3.3节). 这些成果凸显了不同任务和互动要求之间独特的模式优势。 展望未来,我们将实时互动视频视为将全方位模式模式带入多种应用设置的重要挑战.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • Unified interactive benchmark. Five streaming tasks and 300 scripted test cases specify timed multimodal inputs alongside explicit request-execution and state-preservation requirements. • Multidimensional evaluation. Ten task-specific metrics assess task execution and state consistency alongside visual fidelity and audiovisual coordination under a shared session protocol. • Cross-task system study. Evaluating 37 models across 300 test cases reveals limited instruction following in avatar performance and world generation, alongside low full-edit completion in reference editing.
blocks.zh: • 统一互动基准。 5个流式任务和300个脚本测试案例与明确的执行请求和保存国家要求一起,指定了有时间的多式输入。 • 多层面评价。 10个针对具体任务的衡量标准评估任务执行和一致性,以及根据共同会议协议进行的视觉忠诚和视听协调。 • 跨任务系统研究。 对300个测试案例的37个模型进行评估后发现,在模拟性能和世界一代中遵循的教学有限,同时在参考编辑中完成的完全编辑不多。

blocks.en: Unified interactive benchmark. Five streaming tasks and 300 scripted test cases specify timed multimodal inputs alongside explicit request-execution and state-preservation requirements.
blocks.zh: 统一互动基准。 5个流式任务和300个脚本测试案例与明确的执行请求和保存国家要求一起,指定了有时间的多式输入。

blocks.en: Multidimensional evaluation. Ten task-specific metrics assess task execution and state consistency alongside visual fidelity and audiovisual coordination under a shared session protocol.
blocks.zh: 多层面评价。 10个针对具体任务的衡量标准评估任务执行和一致性,以及根据共同会议协议进行的视觉忠诚和视听协调。

blocks.en: Cross-task system study. Evaluating 37 models across 300 test cases reveals limited instruction following in avatar performance and world generation, alongside low full-edit completion in reference editing.

blocks.en: 2 The StreamEval Benchmark
blocks.zh: 2 流源基准

blocks.en: 2.1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 2.1 动机

blocks.en: Real-time interactive video is an important step toward omni-modal systems that continuously perceive, generate, and respond to evolving user needs. Evaluating this capability requires testing whether systems execute new requests while preserving relevant context and state. StreamEval addresses these requirements through five tasks spanning avatar interaction, world generation, and real-time video editing, with task-specific metrics defined in section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 实时互动视频是朝向不断感知、生成和应对不断变化的用户需要的全方位模式系统迈出的重要一步。 评估这种能力需要测试系统是否执行新的请求,同时保留相关的上下文和状态。 StreamEval通过五项任务满足这些要求,这些任务跨越了Avatar交互、世界生成和实时视频编辑,第3.2节规定了具体任务的衡量标准。

blocks.en: Each test case specifies initialization, a timeline of incoming inputs, and expected outcomes. A scheduler releases inputs incrementally and advances editing sources on the session clock. Input events specify when controls arrive; scoring opportunities specify what the system must accomplish or retain.
blocks.zh: 每个测试案例都规定了初始化、输入时间和预期成果。 一个排程器会逐步发布输入,并预发会话钟上的编辑来源. 输入事件指定控制何时到达;积分机会指定系统必须完成或保留什么.

blocks.en: Digital-human dialogue requires contextually appropriate responses to user speech while maintaining persona and conversational history. Avatar performance requires rendering prescribed speech and requested visual actions, such as gaze shifts or hand gestures.
blocks.zh: 数字人-人对话要求对用户的言论作出适合具体情况的反应,同时保持人性和对话历史。 神通表演需要渲染所指定的语音并请求的视觉动作,如凝视移位或手势.

blocks.en: World generation creates evolving scenes in response to successive controls over objects, actions, cameras, or spatial state, while preserving unaffected content and continuity.
blocks.zh: 世界代会针对对物体,动作,相机,或空间状态的相继控制而创造出不断演变的场景,同时保留未受影响的内容和连续性.

blocks.en: Instruction editing applies text-specified changes to an advancing source video; reference editing uses images to specify the desired appearance. Both require modifying the intended target while preserving non-target content and source motion. Removal requests restore the contemporaneous source state.
blocks.zh: 指令编辑将文本指定的修改应用到一个前进的源视频;参考编辑使用图像来指定所期望的外观. 两者都要求修改预定目标,同时保留非目标内容和源动. 清除请求恢复当时的源状态。

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准建设

blocks.en: We pair online inputs with explicit state requirements ( figure 2 ). Qwen3.8-Max drafts session goals, timed controls, protected attributes, and expected outcomes. An authored oracle specifies what to establish, retain, cancel, or restore at each checkpoint. Media inputs are screened and revised against these requirements. All benchmark cases, including their timelines, oracles, and media, will be released together.
blocks.zh: 我们把在线投入与明确的国家要求挂钩(图2)。 Quen3.8-Max 起草会话目标,定时控制,被保护属性,以及预期结果. 撰文者说明在每个检查站设立、保留、取消或恢复什么。 根据这些需要筛选和修订媒体的投入。 所有基准案件,包括其时限、甲骨文和媒体,将一起公布。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Benchmark construction and verification. Model-assisted authoring and input synthesis precede modality-specific checks. A Qwen-Image portrait with hand defects is regenerated and passes the same screening.
blocks.zh: 图2:基准建设与核查。 模式辅助作者和输入综合在模式特定检查之前进行。 带有手部缺陷的Quen-Image相片被再生并经过同样的放映.

blocks.en: Each task covers individual operations, combined requests, and recovery. Dialogue covers factual answers, cross-turn state, turn-taking, and interruption; performance covers speech, gaze, expression, pose, and gestures. World generation tests object and action control, state updates, and camera or spatial continuity. Editing tests target establishment, incremental updates, reference switching, scope preservation, and restoration. Repair, multi-target updates, and reappearance after occlusion add more demanding interactions within the same benchmark.
blocks.zh: 每项任务包括个别业务、合并请求和回收。 对话包括事实答案、交叉转弯状态、转弯和中断;表演包括讲话、凝视、表达、姿态和手势。 世界生成测试对象和动作控制,状态更新,相机或空间连续性. 编辑测试目标建立,增量更新,参考切换,范围保存,并恢复. 修复、多目标更新和隔离后再次出现,增加了同一基准内更严格的互动。

blocks.en: Successive editing controls test whether established changes persist when new requests arrive. Cases include introducing a second target while retaining the first, updating selected attributes, switching references, and removing an edit to restore the advancing source.
blocks.zh: 连续的编辑控制测试,当新请求到来时,既定的更改是否持续. 案例包括引入第二个目标同时保留第一个目标,更新所选属性,切换引用,并去掉一个编辑以恢复推进源.

blocks.en: GPT-Image-2 and Qwen-Image synthesize portraits and visual references; portraits depict original synthetic adults or stylized fictional characters. Qwen3.5-Omni generates expressive user and prescribed speech. Dialogue pairs these recordings with authored personas and verified facts, including recordings with background noise or reverberation. Paired text-dialogue derivatives replace audio turns with authored text while retaining identical source-family identities.
blocks.zh: GPT-Image-2和Qwen-Image合成了肖像和视觉参考;肖像描绘了原始的合成成人或有风格的虚构人物. Quen3.5-Omni生成表达式用户和被指定的语音. 对话将这些录音与作者个人和经核实的事实相配,包括背景噪音或反响的录音。 Paired text-dialogue衍生工具在保留相同的源-家族身份的同时,用作者的文本来取代音频转折.

blocks.en: Editing tracks use continuous source videos comprising licensed real-world footage, animation, and benchmark-generated scenes. Third-party sources include Wikimedia Commons, NASA, and Blender Studio; per-asset licenses and attribution are supplied in the data release. Each source covers the session without looping, speed changes, or concatenation, so edits follow the advancing scene. Target regions are temporally grounded via Qwen3.8-Max at planned control timestamps.
blocks.zh: 编辑曲目使用连续的源视频,包括特许真实世界的镜头,动画,以及基准生成的场景. 第三方来源包括Wikimedia Communitys、NASA和Blender Studio;在数据发布中提供每个资产许可证和归属。 每个源都覆盖会话,没有循环,速度变化,也没有接合,因此会按照推进场景来编辑. 目标区域在计划控制时间戳上通过Qune3.8-Max暂时禁用。

blocks.en: 2.3 Data Statistics
blocks.zh: 2.3 数据统计

blocks.en: Each task contains 60 test cases, balanced across 15, 30, 60, 120, and 300 seconds with 12 cases per duration. Across all five tracks, 300 test cases span 240 independent source families, with 60 text-dialogue derivatives reusing existing families. One pass through the 300 video-session cases represents 525 minutes of active streaming generation, excluding setup and response tails.
blocks.zh: 每项任务包含60个测试案例,在15个、30个、60个、120个和300秒之间保持平衡,每个持续时间为12个案例。 在所有五个音轨中,300个测试案例跨越240个独立来源家庭,60个文本对话衍生工具重用现有家庭. 一个通过300个视频会话案例代表了525分钟的活流生成,不包括设置和响应尾.

blocks.en: The 300 test cases contain 1,347 planned online events, excluding initialization and continuous source frames. Inputs include speech, text, and visual references; each input can impose multiple execution and preservation requirements. Avatar designs span photorealistic, stylized 3D, anime, and clay or stop-motion appearances. Dialogue includes clean speech, background noise, and room reverberation, while editing covers indoor and outdoor scenes with single or multiple targets. Figure 3 summarizes interaction statistics for 200 of these cases.
blocks.zh: 300个测试案例包含1,347个计划中的在线事件,不包括初始化和连续源框. 输入内容包括语音,文本,和可视参考;每个输入可以施加多个执行和保存要求. 阿凡达设计跨越了光现实主义,分型的3D,动能,和粘土或停止运动外观. 对话包括干净的演讲,背景噪音,以及房间回响等,而编辑则覆盖室内外的场景,有单个或多个目标. 图3汇总了其中200起个案的互动统计数据。

The 200 cases shown contain 562 online events, excluding initialization and continuous source frames. Gap statistics exclude pairs containing a trigger.

blocks.en: The evaluation protocol specifies a roster of 300 test cases: 60 per task, with 12 at each duration tier and three independent runs per case and model. The results reported in this paper cover these 300 cases ( section 3.1 ). All five duration strata receive equal aggregation weight within each task, so longer sessions contribute equally to the final assessment rather than in proportion to their duration.
blocks.zh: 评价协议规定了300个测试案例的名册:每个任务60个,每个阶段12个,每个案例和模型3个独立运行。 本文件所报告的结果涉及这300个案件(第3.1节)。 所有五个会期等级在每项任务中都得到同等的汇总权重,因此较长的届会对最后评估的贡献是相等的,而不是与其持续时间的比例。

blocks.en: 2.4 Comparison with Existing Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.4 与现有基准的比较

blocks.en: Table 1 positions StreamEval against existing video generation and interactive benchmarks across task coverage and evaluation horizons. Avatar-performance benchmarks assess rendered speakers, including visual quality and speech-motion synchronization, while Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates spoken dialogue without video output. VideoFDB additionally evaluates full-duplex conversational perception and audiovisual response generation [ 44 ] . Its naturally occurring nonverbal cues complement our authored speech-input dialogue and prescribed-performance tasks; our broader task coverage does not imply coverage of its user-video perception requirements. For video editing, WBench and WBench-Editing focus on world-model environments, while EditVerseBench covers instruction- and reference-conditioned editing of external videos [ 68 , 36 , 29 ] . WBench-Editing also reports a separate reference-conditioned comparison. Task interfaces and control timing jointly define the interaction protocol.
blocks.zh: 表1 职位 StreamEval与现有视频生成和跨任务范围和评价范围的互动基准相对应。 Avatar-性能基准对演讲者进行评估,包括视觉质量和语音动作同步,而Full-Duplex-Bench则评价没有视频输出的口语对话. VideoFDB额外评价了全复式对话感知和视听响应生成[44]. 它自然产生的非口头提示补充了我们作者的语音输入对话和规定的业绩任务;我们更广泛的任务范围并不意味着涵盖其用户-视频感知要求。 为进行视频编辑,W Bench和W Bench-Editing关注世界模式环境,而EditVerse Bench则覆盖了外部视频的指导和参考条件编辑[68,36,29]. WBench-Editing还报告了一个单独的参考条件比较. 任务界面和控制时间共同定义了交互协议.

blocks.en: StreamEval applies a balanced multi-horizon design across all five streaming tasks: 15, 30, 60, 120, and 300 seconds, with 60 test cases at each duration tier. Its 300-second editing cases represent a five-fold expansion over LongV2VBench (60 s), while its world-generation cases extend beyond StreamAV-Bench’s 180-second rollouts [ 59 , 39 ] . Longer avatar sequences already appear in GenBench [ 20 ] ; our contribution is balanced coverage across tasks and durations, with incrementally released multimodal controls and continuously advancing editing sources.
blocks.zh: StreamEval在所有5个流线任务中采用了平衡的多视距设计:15,30,60,120和300秒,每个阶段的测试案例有60个. 其300秒的编辑案例比LongV2V Bench(60 s)增长了5倍,而其世界代案例则超越了StreamAV-Bench的180秒推出[59,39]. Gen Bench [20] 中已经出现了较长的可变序列;我们的贡献是平衡地涵盖各项任务和期限,逐步发布多式联运控制并不断推进编辑来源。

blocks.en: We evaluate 37 models on 300 test cases across these tasks ( section 3.1 ). For context, WBench evaluates 20 models, WorldMark 10, and StreamAV-Bench 13 systems within their respective domains [ 68 , 62 , 39 ] . Our benchmark brings these application domains into a shared framework for assessing request execution and state preservation alongside content quality.
blocks.zh: 我们对这些任务300个测试案例的37个模型进行评估(第3.1节)。 就背景而言,W Bench评价了20个模型,即WorldMark 10和StrewAV-Bench 13系统在各自的域内[68,62,39]. 我们的基准将这些应用领域与内容质量一起纳入一个评估执行请求和国家保存的共同框架。

blocks.en: 2.5 Quality Verification
blocks.zh: 2.5 质量核查

blocks.en: Automated checks verify media decodability and duration bounds, file identity, and agreement among events, opportunities, and scoring requirements ( figure 2 ). Qwen3-ASR transcribes synthesized speech, requiring normalized word-error rates of at most 0.25 against authored transcripts. Qwen3.8-Max audits images for subject clarity and anatomical or rendering defects. Editing sources are checked for scene cuts, frozen spans, and unsuitable targets. Revised candidates must pass the same checks.
blocks.zh: 自动检查核实媒体的可解码性和持续时间范围、文件身份以及事件、机会和评分要求之间的一致(图2)。 Qune3-ASR translatss syndressed speech, 要求普通的文字错误率, 对作曲的笔录最多0.25. Quen3.8-Max 审核图像,以明确对象和解剖或渲染缺陷. 编辑来源被检查为场景剪接,被冻结的跨度和不合适的目标. 经修订的候选人必须通过同样的检查。

blocks.en: Targeted positive and negative probes evaluate automated production judges against acceptance criteria of at most 5% false positive rate, 10% false negative rate, and 10% unresolved decisions per class. Visual critique judges return structured defect categories, severity ratings, and supporting frame timestamps. Identity uses the lower rating from two judges given the same initialization portrait (or the system’s opening frame for a fixed avatar) and sampled output frames to guard against same-style identity substitutions.
blocks.zh: 定向正负探测器对照每类最多5%的假正率,10%的假负率和10%的未决决定等接受标准,评价自动生产判断. 视觉批评法官将结构化的缺陷类别、严重程度评级和支持帧时间戳。 身份使用两个法官的较低评级,给相同的初始化肖像(或系统固定外形的开口框),并抽取出输出相框来防范同式身份替代.

blocks.en: 3 System Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3 系统评价

blocks.en: We evaluate how systems execute evolving requests, retain relevant state, and render the resulting video across the five tasks in section 2 . Each task and input setting has a defined metric profile and an Overall score.
blocks.zh: 我们评价各系统如何执行不断变化的请求,保留相关状态,并在第2节的五项任务中提供所产生的视频。 每项任务和输入设置都有一个确定的度量描述和总分.

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价设置

blocks.en: We report 37 distinct models across 47 task configurations. A task configuration is a model evaluated on one task with its specified input route and any adapter components. A model evaluated on multiple tasks is counted once in the model total and separately for each task configuration. Avatar models include Vidu S2 Avatar [ 72 ] , Tavus CVI Full, LiveAvatar FULL, Runway Characters, Vivix A1, AptAvatar, Avatar-Forever, AvatarForcing, AVTR-1, LiveTalk [ 5 ] , MuseTalk [ 87 ] , Quark Live Avatar, and the SoulX-FlashHead, SoulX-FlashTalk, and SoulX-LiveAct models. World generation covers AlayaWorld, HappyOyster 1.0 Adventure, HY-World 1.5 WorldPlay, LingBot-World 2.0, Matrix-Game 3.5, Causal Forcing, Context Forcing, Helios, Krea Realtime, LongLive 2.0, MemFlow, Reward Forcing, Rolling Forcing [ 40 ] , Self-Forcing, ShotStream, Yume 1.5, and Zing-0.5. Reported editing models include Vidu S2 Editing, JoyAI-Video-Edit [ 59 ] , EditaLive, SANA-Streaming, and XMax X2.0. The editing tables show configurations with Overall at least 5; this presentation subset was selected after evaluation. The model and configuration totals refer to the reported subset. LiveAvatar FULL and Tavus CVI Full use fixed, provider-supplied avatars because avatar customization is unavailable through their evaluated interfaces; Identity is rated against each system’s own opening frame and included in Overall, and their names appear in gray in table 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们报告47个任务组合的37个不同模式。 任务配置是一个对一项任务进行评估的模型,它有指定的输入路径和任何适配器组件. 对多项任务进行评估的模型在模型总数中计算一次,每个任务配置单独计算一次. 阿凡达模型包括:Vidu S2 Avatar [72],Tavus CVI Full,LiveAvatar FUL,跑道字符,Vivix A1,AptAvatar,Avatar-Forever,AvatarForcing,AVTR-1,LiveTalk [5],MuseTalk [87],Quark Live Avatar,和SoulX-Flashhead,SoulX-FlashTalk,和SoulX-LiveAct模型. 世界代包括阿拉亚世界,HappyOyster 1.0 Adventure,HY-World 1.5 WorldPlay,LingBot-World 2.0,Matrix-Game 3.5,Causal Forcing,上下文forcing,Helios,克瑞亚实时,LongLive 2.0,Memflow,回馈forcing,滚出forcing [40],自强,ShotStream,Yume 1.5和Zing-0.5. 被报道的编辑模式包括Vidu S2编辑,JoyAI-Video-Edit [59],EditaLive,SANA-Streaming,和XMax X2.0. 编辑表格显示配置至少有5个;此演示文稿子集是在评价后选定的。 模型和配置总计指报告的子集. LiveAvatar FUL和塔武斯CVI 完全使用固定的、提供商提供的相机,因为无法通过它们被评价的界面定制相机; 身份被评为与每个系统自己的开口框相对应,并被列入总体,其名称在表2中以灰色显示。

blocks.en: The five tasks are digital-human dialogue (15 configurations), avatar performance (7), world generation (17: 12 text-conditioned and 5 image-conditioned), instruction editing (5), and reference editing (3). The evaluation covers 300 test cases (60 in each task) across five equally weighted duration strata from 15 to 300 s, with three repeats per test case and model. World generation includes text-controlled and image-conditioned inputs; the latter adds appearance conditioning.
blocks.zh: 五项任务是:数字-人类对话(15个配置),相机性能(7),世界代(17个:12个文本条件和5个图像条件),指令编辑(5),参考编辑(3). 评价涵盖从15到300秒的五个同等加权时间层的300个测试案例(每项任务60个),每个测试案例和模型重复三次。 世界生成包括文本控制和图像条件输入;后者增加了外观条件.

blocks.en: We report ten metrics across four dimensions: task execution (Dialogue, Following, Edit Success), state consistency (Stability, Continuity, Preservation), visual fidelity (Quality, Identity, Reference), and audiovisual coordination (A–V Sync). Each task reports the equal-weight mean of its applicable metrics as Quality-Overall; avatar tasks additionally report a customization bonus and their sum as Overall.
blocks.zh: 我们从四个方面报告10个衡量标准:任务执行(对话、跟踪、编辑成功)、国家一致性(稳定性、连续性、保存)、视觉忠诚(质量、身份、参考)和视听协调(A-V同步)。 每项任务都报告其适用的衡量标准为 " 质量总体 " 的等重平均值;Avatar任务还报告定制奖金及其总和。

blocks.en: 3.2 Metrics and Scoring
blocks.zh: 3.2 计量和分数

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Task-Specific Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 特定任务计量

blocks.en: All five tasks assess output quality and stability under the expected state sequence, including authorized actions, edits, and restoration. Quality scores five-second clips from primary-judge defect lists: no defect, one minor defect, multiple minor defects, one severe defect, and multiple severe defects give ratings r ∈ { 5 , 4 , 3 , 2 , 1 } r\in\{5,4,3,2,1\} , respectively, with severe defects taking precedence and mapping to 25 ​ ( r − 1 ) 25(r-1) . Stability measures the duration covered by clips with no severe temporal defect, at most one minor temporal defect, and Quality rating at least 3. Because Stability is gated by Quality, the two metrics overlap and a high Stability score requires both temporal consistency and acceptable visual quality.
blocks.zh: 所有五个任务都按照预期状态序列评估产出质量和稳定性,包括授权行动、编辑和恢复。 质量评分从一级裁判员缺陷名单中分出5秒:无缺陷,有1个小缺陷,有多处小缺陷,有1个严重缺陷,有多处严重缺陷分别给予r {{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{{ 稳定度测量没有严重时间缺陷的剪辑覆盖的时间长度,最多一个小时间缺陷,质量评级至少 3个 由于"稳定"是由"质量"(Quality)的入门而来,因此"两个度量衡"的重合和高"稳定"分数要求时间一致性和可接受的视觉质量.

blocks.en: Dialogue measures the percentage of planned turns satisfying answer, content, conversational, and timing requirements. Identity provides the initialization portrait (or the system’s own opening frame for a fixed avatar) and sampled clip frames to two judges, Qwen3.8-Max-0902 and Qwen3-VL-Plus, and takes the lower feature-derived rating while allowing authorized expression, pose, crop, and lighting changes. An explicitly different person or at least three clear feature changes gives rating 1; two clear changes give 2; one clear change or at least three slight changes gives 3; one or two slight changes give 4; no change gives 5. An unclear same-person judgment caps the rating at 3, and the final score is 25 ​ ( r − 1 ) 25(r-1) . A–V Sync measures the percentage of required speech events with lip-opening/audio-envelope correlation at least 0.3, evaluated at a pooled system offset whose 95% interval (2,000 session-bootstrap draws) lies within [ − 200,200 ] [-200,200] ms using 10-ms search steps over [ − 1000 , 1000 ] [-1000,1000] ms. Sparse source sampling (500 ms for dialogue, 250 ms for performance) limits its temporal resolution. Together with Quality and Stability, these metrics evaluate conversational execution, speaker appearance, and audiovisual delivery.
blocks.zh: 对话衡量计划回合中满足答复、内容、谈话和时间安排要求的百分比。 身份提供初始化肖像(或系统自身固定相机的开机相框),并给两个评委(Qune3.8-Max-0902和Qune3-VL-Plus)取出剪辑相框样本,并取取较低的特征衍生分数,同时允许授权的表达,姿势,收成,和照明变化. 明显不同的人或至少三个明显的特征变化给出了1级;两个明显的变化给出了2级;一个明显的变化或至少三个轻微的变化给出了3级;一个或两个轻微的变化给出了4级;没有变化给出了4级. 5 (韩语). 不明同人判断将评分上限为3分,最终得分为25分(r-1分)25分(r-1分). A-V 同步测量至少0.3相通/音频-信封相关且在集合系统中评价的所需语音事件的百分比,其95%的间隔(2,000会话-波茨特拉克绘图)位于[−200] [-200200] ms内,使用10ms的搜索步骤在[−1000,1000] [-1000 1100] ms上进行声源取样(500ms用于对话,250ms用于性能)限制了其时间分辨率. 这些衡量标准与质量和稳定性一道,评价对话执行、演讲人外出和视听传播。

blocks.en: Following measures the percentage of control events in which the avatar executes the requested gaze, expression, pose, or gesture on the specified target. Prescribed speech supplies the verbal content. The task combines Following with Quality, Stability, Identity, and A–V Sync.
blocks.zh: 采取各项措施后,可控事件的百分比,即:可控事件在指定目标上执行所要求的目视、表达、姿态或手势。 限定性发言提供口头内容。 任务与质量、稳定、身份和A-V同步相结合。

blocks.en: Following measures the percentage of online controls that produce the requested scene operation on the specified target; a control passes when every frame in which the target is visible shows the requested outcome fully or partially. Continuity measures the fraction of generated duration meeting motion, camera, object-permanence, transition, and spatial-relation requirements. These two metrics join Quality and Stability in both the text-conditioned and the image-conditioned setting.
blocks.zh: 遵循措施,在指定目标上产生所请求的场景操作的在线控制的百分比;当目标可见的每个帧都全部或部分显示所请求的结果时,控制会通过. 连续测量产生的持续时间会议运动、相机、物体永久性、过渡和空间关系要求的分量。 这两项衡量标准在文字条件和图像条件两方面都与质量和稳定性相结合。

blocks.en: Following checks the requested operation and target, allowing a partial appearance match when no severe leakage occurs. Edit Success requires the complete edit to satisfy scope, active-state, deadline, persistence, and protected-content checks. Preservation assesses non-target content and current source motion, including restoration against the contemporaneous source. Together with Quality and Stability, this profile separates operation execution, full edit completion, source retention, and visual fidelity.
blocks.zh: 在检查请求的操作和目标后,允许在不发生严重泄漏时进行部分外观匹配. 编辑成功需要完整的编辑来满足范围,活动状态,最后期限,持久性,和保护内容检查. 保存评估非目标内容和当前源运动,包括对照当时源恢复. 本剖面与"质量与稳定性"(Quality and Stability)一起,将操作执行,全编辑完成,源保存,和视觉忠贞分别.

blocks.en: Reference measures declared appearance attributes at checkpoints where the supplied image is active, whereas avatar Identity compares against the initialization portrait or, for fixed-avatar interfaces, the system’s opening frame. Edit Success checks the full editing contract, Preservation assesses protected source content and motion, and Quality and Stability complete the five-metric profile.
blocks.zh: 参考措施宣布了所提供图像活跃的检查站的外观属性,而Avatar身份则与初始化肖像相提并论,或者,对于固定的-avatar接口,则与系统的开口框架相提并论。 编辑成功检查了完整的编辑合同,保存评估了受保护的源内容和运动,质量和稳定性完成了五度剖面.

blocks.en: 3.3 Experimental Results

blocks.en: Vidu S2 Editing (45.43 Overall) and JoyAI-Video-Edit [ 59 ] (42.39 Overall) lead instruction editing by a wide margin over the remaining three reported models ( table 5 ). blocks.en: The distribution of metrics across both leading and mid-tier systems highlights the multi-constraint structure of streaming instruction editing. While Following assesses the requested operation and target, Edit Success evaluates complete editing requirements including scope, timing, persistence, and protected-content requirements (Following / Edit Success: 72.10 / 57.20 for Vidu S2 Editing, 63.89 / 43.52 for JoyAI-Video-Edit, and 12.04 / 4.26 for EditaLive (14B)). Meanwhile, Quality (up to 22.99) and Stability (up to 13.94) remain low even for the highest-scoring systems, indicating the difficulty of sustaining clean temporal rendering during live edits.
blocks.zh: 衡量标准在主要系统和中级系统之间的分布突出了流化指令编辑的多约束结构. 在评估了所要求的操作和目标之后,“成功编辑”评价了完整的编辑要求,包括范围、时间、持久性和保护内容要求(“成功编辑”:Vidu S2编辑72.10/57.20,JoyAI-Video-Edit63.89/43.52,EditaLive(14B)12.04/4.26)。 同时,即使是最高评分的系统,质量(最高22.99分)和稳定性(最高13.94分)仍然很低,这表明在现场编辑期间难以保持清洁的时间渲染。

blocks.en: The benchmark combines synthetic portraits and speech, controlled acoustic variations, and licensed source videos. Its editing tasks test reference switching, multi-target retention, and restoration against an advancing source video, while future extensions can cover broader identities and environments, global resets, and selective restoration while concurrent edits remain active.

blocks.en: 5.1.1 Streaming Video Generation

blocks.en: Incremental video synthesis requires efficient sampling and temporal models that can use previously generated content. StreamDiffusion develops efficient pipelines for interactive image synthesis [ 31 ] , while Diffusion Forcing provides a flexible formulation for sequence prediction [ 2 ] . CausVid brings few-step distillation to causal video generation [ 67 ] ; Self Forcing and Causal Forcing further address the mismatch between training and autoregressive inference [ 19 , 97 ] . Causal Forcing++ further studies frame-wise generation with one or two sampling steps [ 90 ] . rCM scales consistency distillation to large image and video models, and Causal-rCM extends it to autoregressive streaming diffusion [ 95 , 94 ] . Speculative decoding for video generation uses a smaller drafter and a quality router to reduce target-model computation [ 18 ] . StreamDiT and StreamDiffusionV2 develop continuous generation and serving pipelines [ 30 , 10 ] , making incremental synthesis practical for interactive applications.
blocks.zh: 递增的视频合成需要高效的采样和时间模型,可以使用以前生成的内容. StreamDifumation开发出用于交互式图像合成的高效管线,而Dreamfumation Forcing则为序列预测提供灵活的配体[2]. 原因 Vid为因果视频生成带来了几步分馏[67]; Self Forcing and Causal Forcing 进一步解决了训练与自发推论的不匹配[19,97]. Causal Forcing++ 进一步研究一两个采样步骤的帧式生成[90]. rCM将一致性分级为大型图像和视频模型,Causal-rCM将其扩展为自回流传播[95,94]. 用于视频生成的分光解码使用更小的起草器和质量路由器来减少目标-模型计算 [18]. StreamDiT和SreamDifmusionV2开发了连续生成并服务于管道[30,10],使渐进合成实用于交互式应用.

blocks.en: Efficient attention methods span hardware-efficient kernels, sparsity, compact representations, and linear formulations [ 76 ] . SageAttention and its successors accelerate low-bit inference [ 80 , 71 , 82 , 79 ] , while SageBwd studies low-bit training [ 70 ] ; dynamic block-level INT8 fallback handles training-time activation outliers [ 85 ] . SpargeAttention and SpargeAttention2 study sparse attention, while SLA and SLA2 combine sparse and linear computation [ 81 , 74 , 77 , 78 ] . Sparse VideoGen and Sparse VideoGen2 exploit spatial-temporal sparsity and semantic grouping, and SVG-EAR adds error-aware routing and linear compensation [ 57 , 65 , 96 ] . Mixed-precision quantization and diffusion distillation further reduce video-generation cost [ 48 , 83 ] . Related image-generation work studies pixel- and timestep-level model stitching for diffusion acceleration [ 50 ] .
blocks.zh: 高效的注意方法跨越高硬件效率的内核,相接性,紧凑的表示和线性配体[76]. SageAtting及其后继者加速了低位推论[80,71,82,79],而SageBwd则研究了低位训练[70];动态块级INT8倒置手柄为训练-时间活化出局器[85]. blocks.en: Flash-KMeans targets online clustering for token grouping and KV-cache quantization [ 64 ] . KernelBenchX evaluates correctness and hardware efficiency of LLM-generated GPU kernels [ 53 ] . TurboServe addresses stateful-session scheduling and GPU provisioning [ 26 ] ; Vidu S1 and S2 connect efficient synthesis to live character interaction and streaming editing [ 73 , 72 ] . These implementation advances motivate measuring client-observed response and sustained delivery alongside content quality.
blocks.zh: Flash-KMEANs瞄准在线集成以表示符号集成和KV-cache量化[64]. Kernel BenchX评价LLM生成的GPU内核的正确性和硬件效率[53]. TurboServe 地址为状态会话排程和GPU提供 [26]; Vidu S1和S2连接高效的合成与活字符交互和流编辑 [73, 72]. 这些执行进展促使衡量客户的观察反应和持续交付以及内容质量。

blocks.en: Sustained generation adds the problem of retaining useful history as the stream grows. FramePack bounds the context cost by compressing historical frames [ 84 ] ; Rolling Forcing, Reward Forcing, and Helios address accumulated drift and motion degradation over long rollouts [ 40 , 42 , 69 ] . Context Forcing trains with longer historical context, while MemFlow retrieves relevant past frames [ 4 , 23 ] . Changing requests also require deciding which earlier states remain relevant. LongLive supports prompt transitions during generation [ 63 ] , and Yume-1.5 adds text-controlled world events [ 43 ] . IAMFlow tracks persistent entities across narrative updates [ 38 ] , and SEGUE models the intermediate state changes needed to execute a prompt switch [ 46 ] . Quant VideoGen compresses autoregressive KV caches, UltraViCo addresses video-length extrapolation, and ViewRoPE introduces camera-ray geometry for spatial persistence [ 56 , 89 , 58 ] . These developments connect long-term memory with selective adaptation to new controls.
blocks.zh: 持续的一代又增加了随着溪流增加而保留有用历史的问题. 框架 包通过压缩历史帧来限定上下文成本 [84]; 滚出要塞,回取要塞,和赫利俄斯地址在长时间展开时累积漂移和运动降解 [40, 42, 69]. 将历史背景较长的列车强制列车,而MemFlow则取回了相关的过去帧 [4,23]. 更改请求还需要确定哪些先前的国家仍然具有相关性。 LongLive支持生成过程中的即时过渡[63],而Yume-1.5又增加了由文本控制的世界事件[43]. 行政会议 flow tracks 持久实体跨越叙事更新[38],而SEGUE 模式是执行快速切换所需的中间状态变化[46]. 量子视频 Gen压缩自回向 KV 缓存, UltraViCo 处理视频长外推, ViewRoPE 引入相机-射线几何空间持久性 [56, 89, 58]. 这些发展将长期记忆与选择性地适应新控制联系起来.

blocks.en: Avatar generation applies these capabilities to speech, identity, and bodily motion. VASA-1 animates portraits from supplied audio, MuseTalk focuses on identity-preserving lip synchronization [ 87 ] , and OmniAvatar extends audio-driven synthesis to text-controlled body animation [ 61 , 13 ] . Live Avatar, SoulX-FlashTalk, and AvatarForcing pursue efficient, sustained avatar rendering [ 20 , 47 , 7 ] . SoulX-LiveAct extends sustained human animation with compressed historical memory [ 92 ] . Joint audiovisual models also generate both modalities during streaming, as in OmniForcing and Omni-LiveAvatar [ 49 , 99 ] . TurboT2VA studies efficient joint audio-video synthesis through consistency distillation [ 66 ] . Conversational interaction additionally requires deciding what to say and when to respond, drawing on real-time speech dialogue in Moshi and multimodal interactive synthesis in LiveTalk [ 8 , 5 ] . This progression motivates separate evaluation of prescribed avatar performance and dialogue behavior.
blocks.zh: 神通一代将这些能力应用于语言,身份,和身体运动. VASA-1动画从提供的音频取出相片,MuseTalk专注于保留身份的唇同步 [87],而OmniAvatar将音频驱动合成扩展至文本控制体动画 [61,13]. Live Avatar, SoulX-FlashTalk,和AvatarForcing 追求高效,持续的Avatar渲染[20,47,7]. SoulX-LiveAct以压缩历史记忆来扩展持续的人类动画 [92]. 如OmniForcing和Omni-LiveAvatar[49、99],联合视听模式在流派中也产生两种模式。 TurboT2VA通过一致性分馏研究高效联合音频-视频合成[66]. 对话性互动还需要决定应说什么和何时应答,利用Moshi语的实时语音对话和LiveTalk语的多模式互动合成[8,5]. 这一进展促使对规定的阿凡达性能和对话行为进行单独评价。

blocks.en: 5.1.2 Streaming Video Editing
blocks.zh: 5.1.2 流媒体编辑

blocks.en: Video editing introduces an external source whose content and motion constrain the generated output. InstructPix2Pix establishes instruction-conditioned image editing, while TokenFlow addresses consistency across edited video frames [ 1 , 14 ] . StreamV2V and Live2Diff support incremental processing through historical features and causal attention [ 35 , 60 ] . Recent work combines efficient inference with stronger editing and preservation: LiveEdit and SANA-Streaming develop few-step streaming editors [ 55 , 91 ] , StreamEdit adapts streaming generators without additional training [ 28 ] , and EgoEdit targets egocentric scenes with hand–object interactions [ 33 ] . JoyAI-Video-Edit further addresses source drift during sustained autoregressive editing [ 59 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频编辑引入了一个外部来源,其内容和动作限制了所生成的输出. 指令Pix2Pix 建立带指导条件的图像编辑,而Token 流程涉及经编辑的视频框架的一致性[1,14]. StreamV2V和Live2Diff通过历史特征和因果关注支持递增处理[35,60]. 最近的工作结合了高效推论与更强的编辑和保存:LiveEdit和SANA-Streaming开发了几步流线编辑[55,91],StreamEdit在不经过额外训练的情况下改造了流线发电机[28],而EgoEdit则以手-对象交互为目标自心场景[33]. JoyAI-Video-Edit进一步解决了持续自递编辑过程中的源漂. [59].

blocks.en: Editing controls specify both the desired appearance and the content to preserve. VACE unifies images, source videos, and masks as conditioning inputs, with an autoregressive adaptation enabling streaming use [ 27 , 12 ] . EditaLive transfers appearance from edited references while retaining character motion [ 34 ] , and Vidu S2-Editing combines source and reference conditioning for streaming edits [ 72 ] . These interfaces support different editing requests. In StreamEval, successive instructions or references specify when an edit should take effect, which established changes should persist, and when edited content should return to the current source.
blocks.zh: 编辑控件同时指定要保存的外观和内容. VACE将图像、源视频和口罩统一为调制输入,并采用可自动回放的可流化使用[27、12]。 EditaLive从被编辑的参考文献中传输外观,同时保留字符运动 [34],而Vidu S2-Editing结合了源和参考条件来进行流编辑 [72]. 这些界面支持不同的编辑请求. 在 StreamEval 中,相继发布的指令或参考文献指定了编辑何时生效,确定更改的时间应该持续,编辑后的内容应该返回到当前来源.

blocks.en: 5.2 Evaluating Streaming Video Systems
blocks.zh: 5.2 评价流线视频系统

blocks.en: Video evaluation has progressed from distributional measures such as Fréchet Video Distance [ 52 ] to decomposed assessments of visual quality, motion, and semantic fidelity in VBench, VBench++, and EvalCrafter [ 21 , 22 , 41 ] . T2V-CompBench and GenAI-Bench examine compositional alignment [ 51 , 32 ] , while VBench-2.0 broadens evaluation to intrinsic faithfulness, including physics and commonsense [ 93 ] . Video-Bench studies human-aligned judging of generated videos [ 15 ] ; MLLM-as-a-Judge examines multimodal judges across scoring, comparison, and ranking [ 3 ] . Together, these works provide content-level evaluation foundations and motivate checking the reliability of automated judgments.
blocks.zh: 视频评价已从Fréchet视频远程[52]等分发措施,到V Bench、V Bench++和EvalCrafter[21、22、41]对视觉质量、运动和语义忠诚度的分解评估。 T2V-Comp Bench和GenAI-Bench检查了成分配对[51,32],而V Bench-2.0则将评价范围扩大到了内在的忠实,包括物理和常识[93]. Video-Bench研究人类对生成的视频的判断[15]; MLLM-as-a-Judge审查跨得分、比较和排名的多式联运法官[3]。 这些作品共同提供了内容层面的评价基础并激励检查自动化判断的可靠性.

blocks.en: Evaluating evolving content requires examining both intended changes and retained state. TC-Bench assesses the completion of transitions between specified scene states [ 11 ] . NarraStream-Bench evaluates entity grounding, cross-segment consistency, and instruction following under multiple narrative prompts [ 38 ] ; MBench examines entity, environment, and causal consistency as aspects of world-model memory [ 86 ] . OpenTrans-360 further evaluates how earlier states end and new states emerge during prompt switches [ 46 ] . ViewBench diagnoses loop-closure fidelity and geometric drift [ 58 ] . These benchmarks establish temporal behavior and memory as evaluation targets beyond the quality of individual frames.
blocks.zh: 评价演变中的内容需要既审查打算进行的修改,也审查保留状态。 TC-Bench评估特定场景状态之间的过渡完成情况[11]. 纳拉 Stream-Bench在多个叙事提示下评价实体地平面,交叉分块的一致性,以及遵循的指令[38];MBench作为世界模型记忆的方面来审查实体,环境和因果的一致性[86]. OpenTrans-360进一步评价了更早的状态如何结束和在即时开关期间出现的新状态[46]. View Bench)诊断出环相闭的忠诚和几何漂移[58]. 这些基准将时间行为和内存确定为超越单个帧质量的评价目标.

blocks.en: Interactive benchmarks connect generated changes to successive controls. A first-principles account of general world models places such interaction within a broader cycle of understanding, imagination, and action [ 98 ] . WorldScore assesses world controllability, quality, and dynamics [ 9 ] , while WorldMark standardizes scenes and action interfaces across interactive world models [ 62 ] . WBench evaluates multi-turn navigation, subject actions, event editing, and perspective changes [ 68 ] ; its event edits modify the generated world. EditWorld’s WBench-Editing examines successive world edits and preservation of unrelated content through a main text-only comparison and a separate reference-conditioned subset [ 36 ] . StreamAV-Bench addresses streaming audio-video generation through progressive and interactive tracks, assessing prompt updates, response realization, and state retention and reuse [ 39 ] . Its diagnostics also account for unsuccessful updates. These protocols already capture important aspects of interactive behavior, providing direct points of comparison for StreamEval.
blocks.zh: 交互式基准将生成的更改连接到相继的控制. 一般性世界模型的第一原则将这种互动置于一个更广泛的理解、想象和行动周期之内[98]。 世界 得分评估世界可控性、质量和动态[9],而世界 Mark将场景和动作界面标准化,跨越交互式世界模型[62]. W Bench评价多回合导航,主题动作,事件编辑,以及视角变化[68];其事件编辑会修改生成的世界. EditWorld's W Bench-Editing通过仅以正文为主的比较和一个单独的参考条件子集[36]来审查相继的世界编辑和保存不相干的内容. StreamAV-Bench通过渐进式和互动式的轨道处理流音视频生成,评估及时更新,响应实现,以及状态保存和再利用[39]. 其诊断结果也导致更新不成功。 这些协议已经抓住了交互行为的重要方面,为StreatEval提供了直接的比较点.

blocks.en: Avatar evaluation adds identity and audiovisual requirements. SyncNet provides a measure of lip synchronization [ 6 ] , while THEval and Live Avatar’s GenBench evaluate rendered speakers, including visual quality and synchronization across different durations [ 45 , 20 ] . Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates conversational behaviors such as pausing, backchanneling, turn-taking, and interruption [ 37 ] . VideoFDB evaluates full-duplex audiovisual conversation through separate perception and generation assessments of nonverbal cues [ 44 ] . This emphasis on conversational appropriateness complements our dialogue execution and prescribed-performance tasks, which do not test perception of a live user-video stream. These complementary assessments distinguish the quality of a rendered performance from the behavior of a system participating in a conversation.
blocks.zh: " 神通 " 评估增加了身份和视听要求。 SyncNet提供了口语同步的度量 [6],而THEval和Live Avatar的"Gen Bench"则评价了成语,包括视觉质量和不同时期的同步[45,20]. Full-Duplex-Bench评价了对话行为,比如"穷困","回向","取回"和"中断"[37]. VideoFDB通过对非语言提示的单独感知和生成评估来评价全复式视听对话[44]. 这种对对话适当性的强调,补充了我们的对话执行和规定的业绩任务,这些任务不测试对现场用户-视频流的看法。 这些补充评估将所表现的质量与参与对话的系统的行为区分开来。

blocks.en: Editing benchmarks assess requested changes together with source preservation. TDVE-DB provides human ratings of quality, alignment, and structural consistency for TDVE-Assessor [ 54 ] . EditVerseBench covers diverse editing operations, including reference insertion and first-frame propagation [ 29 ] . LiveEdit benchmarks streaming editing [ 55 ] , while EgoEditBench emphasizes egocentric edits and preservation under hand–object interactions [ 33 ] . CharEdit-Bench evaluates character transformations over short and long videos [ 34 ] , and LongV2VBench tests global and local editing operations over long videos [ 59 ] . These studies make source retention and long-horizon editing quality important complements to edit alignment.
blocks.zh: 编辑基准评估请求的修改以及源的保护。 TDVE-DB为TDVE-Assessor[54]提供质量,相接性和结构一致性的人类评级. 编辑Verse Bench涵盖多种编辑操作,包括引用插入和第一帧传播[29]. LiveEdit基准流出编辑[55],而"EgoEdit Bench"则强调以自我为中心的编辑和在手-对象交互下保存[33]. CharEdit-Bench评价短视频和长视频的人物转换[34],以及长V2 V Bench通过长相视频测试全球和地方编辑操作 [59]. 这些研究使源头保留和长视野编辑质量成为编辑校正的重要补充.

blocks.en: StreamEval brings these evaluation requirements together across dialogue, prescribed avatar performance, world generation, instruction editing, and reference editing. Each task specifies when inputs become available, what should change, and which state or source content should remain. The resulting assessment links task execution and state consistency with visual fidelity and audiovisual coordination. Section 2.4 compares five-task coverage and evaluation duration across existing benchmarks.
blocks.zh: StreamEval将这些评价要求汇集到各种对话、规定的外观表现、世界生成、指令编辑和参考编辑中。 每项任务都具体规定了何时可以提供投入、应该改变什么以及应该保留哪些内容或源内容。 评估结果将任务执行与视觉忠诚和视听协调联系起来。 第2.4节比较了现有基准的五个任务范围和评价期限。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: StreamEval brings five interactive streaming video tasks into a unified benchmark of 300 scripted test cases, linking evolving requests to explicit execution and state-preservation requirements. Our evaluation of 37 models reveals complementary strengths across tasks, while online action following and reference-based editing remain challenging. In reference editing, the highest reported Edit Success score is 15.00 on a 0–100 scale. Improving request execution alongside visual fidelity and state continuity is therefore an important direction for future model design. A natural next step is to collect human pairwise judgments and examine their agreement with the task-specific evaluation rubric. Together, these directions support progress toward omni-modal real-time interactive applications that integrate continuous perception, generation, and responsive control.
blocks.zh: StreamEval将5个互动流视频任务纳入300个脚本测试案例的统一基准,将不断发展的请求与明确的执行和状态保护要求联系起来. 我们评价了37个模式,揭示了各项任务之间的互补性优势,而在线行动和基于参考的编辑仍然具有挑战性。 在参考编辑中,报告的最高"成功编辑"得分为:0-100分. 因此,在改进请求执行的同时提高视觉忠诚度和状态连续性是未来模型设计的一个重要方向。 下一个自然步骤是收集人类对等判断,并审查这些判断与特定任务评价主题的一致。 这些方向共同支持实现全时模式实时互动应用程序,这些应用程序将持续感知、生成和反应控制结合起来。
